name: task-edge-target-absent-drift-prune
body: finalize_graph drops a task edge whose target FQN is absent from the branch graph: a creates/target edge to an FQN not declared as a planned node is pruned, the same drift policy as implemented-by. Limit: the plan surface cannot deliberately name an undeclared planned destination. Upgrade if that surface starts naming undeclared planned destinations: add explicit admission rather than the silent prune. Two further limits. (1) finalize_graph does not GC unreferenced UnresolvedTarget nodes (only the delta path does); upgrade if a stray orphan placeholder ever needs pruning on a full scan — the closed-graph rule (every edge endpoint is a real node or a live unresolved target) holds without it. (2) The kind_is-based authored/plan tables carry the membership invariant through their node lookup rather than an explicit live-set test; upgrade to a literal per-table live check if the pass must be mechanically uniform.
